definitions.explanation: Four children born together from a single pregnancy. From {四|よ}つ (four) plus {子|こ} (child), which voices to ご.

examples.japanese: あの{家|いえ}は{四|よ}つ{子|ご}を{育|そだ}てている。
{四|よ}つ{子|ご}を{見分|みわ}けるのはとても{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's very hard to tell the quadruplets apart.

notes:
{四|よ}つ (four) plus {子|こ} (child); こ voices to ご in the compound.

RELATED WORDS:
- {双子|ふたご}: twins
- {三|みつ}つ{子|ご}: triplets
- {五|いつ}つ{子|ご}: quintuplets

NOTE:
These multiple-birth words use the native counting series ({双子|ふたご}, {三|みつ}つ{子|ご}, {四|よ}つ{子|ご}, {五|いつ}つ{子|ご}), not the Sino-Japanese numbers.
